claim_boundary: Source-linked metadata and local schema validation only. No benchmark task text, screenshots, credentials, emulator/VM assets, MCP service state, verifier output, or live external side effect was downloaded or executed. A train-policy row still requires a separate byte/hash acquisition receipt and source-specific adapter; runtime rows require release-matched native execution before scoring.

sources.primary_metric: Exact normalized action and episode/trajectory success on official app/task splits.
sources.split_rule: Train only on the official training partition; hold out app/task generalization splits.

sources.primary_metric: Action/trajectory exactness under official task-app-platform splits.
sources.split_rule: Keep unseen instruction, app, and platform partitions out of training.

sources.primary_metric: AnswerSheet task success, dense state reward, and sim-to-real retention.

sources.primary_metric: Strict task pass and rubric score by single-app, multi-app, and memory/personalization categories.

sources.primary_metric: Long-horizon task success across agent-user and MCP-augmented workflows.

sources.primary_metric: Task completion over 100 tasks and 10 open-source apps.

sources.primary_metric: Mobile task completion and API/UI action accuracy.

sources.primary_metric: Closed-loop episode reward, success, action error, and timeout rate.

sources.primary_metric: Element accuracy, operation F1, step success, and task success.

sources.primary_metric: Intent match, element IoU, text F1, and micro action metrics.

sources.primary_metric: Execution-based task success on real desktop environments.

sources.primary_metric: Long-horizon execution success and task completion.

sources.primary_metric: Intermediate and final milestone success over arbitrary stateful trajectories.
